title: IS12:: babyweighting.c (9.4)

lines.explanation: This constant defines how many newborn babies the program will process in one run.

lines.code: float weight[NBABIES]; /* elements from ar[0] to ar[DIM-1]; */
lines.explanation: The array weight will have NBABIES elements (here 7). This is exactly as many as we need to store data about all babies entered in one run. This is an array of float numbers since we need good precision for representing the weight.
The variable i is used as a service variable - I will be the loop counter for two for loops in the program

The variable sum will store the total weight of all babies, it has to be initialized to zero. The variable max will store the weight of the heaviest baby. It is also initialized to zero. That will insure that re-assigned in the loop below since any baby i
This for loop will be executed NBABIES times with i running from 0 to NBABIES-1
It's a prompt to enter the weight of i-th baby
The weight of i-th baby entered by the user will be stored in weight[i]
The weight of just entered baby stored in weight[i] is added to the total sum
The weight of just entered baby stored in weight[i] is compared agains the max weight. If it is greater than the current max, it max will be reassigned to  weight[i].
Here we compute the average weight. Since we know that exactlt NBABIES babies will be processed, we do not need to count them.
This for loop will be executed NBABIES times with i running from 0 to NBABIES-1. This is a reporting loop. The weight of each baby stored in the array will be printed and compared with the average.
This is the difference between the weight of the i-th baby and the average weight

If the difference is positive (the baby is heavier than average), the condition is true (1) and the weight will be reported in then part. Otherwise, the baby is lighter and the weight is reported in else part.

lines.code: printf("(%.2f heavier than the average)\n", diff);
lines.explanation: Here we report babies that are heavier than average
Here we report babies that are lighter than average. Not that we need to print -diff, not just diff since the value of diff is negative.
